description: The OS NGD Buildings theme of the Ordnance Survey National Geographic Database holds features meeting the definition of a permanent roofed construction, usually with walls, and is sold as the OS Building Features collection. It is made up of Building, Building Access Location, Building Line and Building Part feature types, with OSID as the main identifier and TOIDs on some features. Compared with OS MasterMap it adds attributes such as detailed land use and land cover, roof shape, aspect and material, solar panel and green roof presence, number of floors, building age, basement presence, construction material, embedded heights, number of addresses and lifecycle status, and access points for vehicles, pedestrians and emergency services at key public buildings. Coverage: Great Britain. Access: download through OS Select+Build and the OS NGD APIs in CSV, GeoJSON, GeoPackage and vector tiles, updated daily, with free sample data. Licence: OS premium licence; paid for commercial use, with sample data and a Data Exploration Licence offered. Caveats: several attributes such as age and construction material are derived or modelled, and Northern Ireland is not included. Simulation uses are building-level exposure, retrofit and hard-to-heat housing analysis, and emergency access planning. Related records: OS Open Linked Identifiers and the England and Wales energy performance certificates.
